standard.title: Present descriptions and explanations
standard.description: present descriptions and explanations, using ideas from sources and relevant subject-specific terms
standard.prior_knowledge: From Y2 (AC9HS2S06): Students developed narratives and shared observations using time and place vocabulary.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students present descriptions and explanations using ideas from sources and relevant subject-specific terms from history, geography and civics.

nodes.label: Subject-specific vocabulary — three disciplines
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use appropriate subject-specific terms from history, geography and civics in speech and writing.
nodes.minimum_width: Use at least two terms from at least two different HASS disciplines accurately in describing or explaining a topic.
nodes.typical_width: Use historical terms (immigration, exploration, development, settlement, commemoration, emblems), geographical terms (climate, environment, natural, constructed) and civic terms (community, decision-making, participation) when speaking, writing and illustrating.
wider: Create a multi-disciplinary glossary for a HASS investigation topic that includes terms from all three disciplines
Identify which discipline's terms are most useful for explaining a specific event or issue and explain why
nodes.hinge_reason: Cross-disciplinary vocabulary is required for Y3 HASS communication across history, geography and civics — students without this vocabulary cannot produce descriptions and explanations that meet the descriptor.

response_modes.reason: Three-discipline vocabulary requires deliberate, sustained practice — use word walls, glossaries and explicit embedding in all inquiry outputs.

success_criteria: Uses at least two terms from at least two different HASS disciplines
Terms are used accurately in context (not just listed)

nodes.label: Presenting using sources
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can present descriptions and explanations that select relevant ideas from sources and use subject-specific terms throughout.
nodes.minimum_width: Present a description or explanation that uses at least one idea from a source and at least two subject-specific terms.
nodes.typical_width: Select ideas from sources (graphs, tables, timelines, photographs, pictures) to support descriptions and explanations; use subject-specific terms from all three HASS disciplines in speech, writing and illustration.
wider: Create a multimodal explanation that integrates visual sources, data displays and written description with accurate subject-specific vocabulary
Present an explanation to an audience and evaluate whether the vocabulary used was appropriate for that audience

response_modes.reason: Communicating integrates source ideas with subject-specific vocabulary into a coherent explanation — the communication is the integration of all Year 3 inquiry skills.

success_criteria: Incorporates at least one source idea in the presentation
Uses at least two subject-specific terms accurately
